role: Static English help content for five categories (AI Assistant, Get Me Back, Your Data, Personalization, App Navigation) as HelpCategory/HelpArticle/ArticleSection literals; HelpContent.categories(forAge:) localizes them via HelpLocalization at hand-out.
types: extension HelpContent — static categories aiAssistant, getMeBack, yourData, personalization, appNavigation
toplevel: All content is stored-property initializers: user-facing claims about the app, including numeric facts (25 remembered facts, 8 tool calls per question, 4,096-token Apple context trimmed at 70%, 600 ms/300 ms/2-word voice interrupt gates, 25 m/60 s address refresh and 5-minute freshness, GPS arrow tiers 10/30/100 m, 50 archived trails, 90-day Trash, 5-attempt strap retry, 10/30-minute sync throttle, 14 system tags, 12 custom-tag colors, 60 RR minimum and 300–2000 ms import bounds, 17 languages, 6 themes, 30-day trial, 14 nights before a score, score bands 90/75/60/45/30, 60-day baseline, 60/25/15 and 70/30 weights, 10-session pagination, 5.5 breaths/min) and AI model names per provider. Spot checks: maxFacts = 25 (Assistant/Chat/UserFactsStore.swift:149), maxToolCallsPerTurn = 8 (Assistant/ViewModel/AssistantViewModel+Tools.swift:30), trial durationDays = 30 (Services/EntitlementAnchor.swift:460), model display names match the provider files (e.g. OpenAIProvider.swift:20 'GPT-6 Luna', GeminiProvider.swift:54 '3.8 Flash'), Settings → Biometrics has homeAddressSection (BiometricsSettingsPage+Sections.swift:28). Other numbers were not verified in this chunk. appNavigation (line 657) lacks the @MainActor annotation the other four carry, but the enclosing enum is @MainActor so isolation is the same.
